source_rule: CORE_SELLABLE_RESTAURANT section 8 (owner directive 2026-10-25): an open business decision becomes the Egyptian-market best practice as a profile value, labelled MARKET_CONVENTION, with DOMAIN's confidence and the question for the expert. The profile is data applied once at provisioning through settings.ApplyMarketProfile; later changes go through Settings.UpdatePolicy under SENSITIVE_POLICY_CHANGE. Confidence is DOMAIN's estimate of market practice, not a legal opinion; every MEDIUM or LOW row and every tax or fiscal row is confirmed by the expert or the accountant before the pilot.
